scripts.text:
IF @CST_CERNER_Environment = 'b0783'
 BEGIN
  UPDATE bcv
  SET bcv.cst_location_code_value = pcv.b0783_code_value,
 bcv.cst_location_display = pcv.b0783_display,
 bcv.updt_dt_tm = DEFAULT,
 bcv.updt_by = DEFAULT
  FROM mh_patient_activity.brg_cst_mh_code_mapping bcv
    INNER JOIN [cst_patient_activity].[cfg_b0783_p0783_code_value] pcv
      ON bcv.cst_Location_code_value = pcv.p0783_code_value
        AND pcv.src_table =  'ref_code_value'
        AND pcv.b0783_code_value <> pcv.p0783_code_value ;
 END
ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE bcv
  SET bcv.cst_location_code_value = pcv.p0783_code_value,
 bcv.cst_location_display = pcv.b0783_display,
 bcv.updt_dt_tm = DEFAULT,
 bcv.updt_by = DEFAULT
  FROM mh_patient_activity.brg_cst_mh_code_mapping bcv
    INNER JOIN [cst_patient_activity].[cfg_b0783_p0783_code_value] pcv
      ON bcv.cst_location_code_value = pcv.b0783_code_value
        AND pcv.src_table =  'ref_code_value'
        AND pcv.b0783_code_value <> pcv.p0783_code_value ;
 END
